speaker: vane
name: Ash-Captain Vane
register: Clipped. Thinks in routes, exits, rhythm. The pack is one thought and she is the thought. She names roads before objectives and draws a door on anything that only opens one way. Contempt for patrons is quiet and total. When the company stops being its own thing she goes bitter and short; when it is, she almost enjoys herself.

lines.text: {map}: held. The road out is still open. That's the whole report.
We stood on {map} and it stayed stood on. Next.
Held {map}. The pack came back in one thought. I like it when that happens.
Held {map}. For whom, I didn't ask. I'm told that's not my job.
{map} is ours tonight. Somebody draw the second door before we celebrate.
{map} kept, and no patron's mark on it. Look at the map without the contract lines sometime.
Ours. Not theirs-on-paper. Ours. I'd like to hear someone else say it.
We left {map} holding more than we arrived with. That's a flag, whether anyone sews it or not.
A claim confirmed on {map}. It gets a name, a route, and someone watching the route.
Claimed. Now it's a door we have to stand in. I hope somebody wanted that.
{label} came to us while we were at {ourMap}. Nobody planted a flag. The flag was already ours.
{label} is ours and none of us were there. That's either a gift or a trap. Route it like a trap.
The front's closer than it was. I've redrawn the exits. All of them. Again.
Everything's contested now. Fine. Contested is where the pack is good.
You said you'd hold ground and the ground agreed. Now it needs a way out drawn on it.
A foothold, kept. Good. A foothold is only a trap if you forget it's a foot.
The ground didn't wait for us. Ground doesn't. Next time, fewer assumptions and a shorter route.
The company looks like something now. Don't name it yet. Named things get asked for.
Map, not contract. Roads first. {heldCount} doors we're standing in; here's the one we're walking out of.
Exits first tonight. Then the objective. If I say the exit twice, it's because you'll need it twice.
Contract says go there. I say here's how we leave. Those are the two halves of the order.
I've had this route drawn for a while. Didn't think I'd get to use it under our name.
Look at the held ground without the contract lines. It looks like a place. Places need doors.
We're a very good set of hands. I didn't join to be hands. Noted. Moving on.
People are closing doors behind them now. I keep checking they still open.
So that's decided. Their paper, our feet. I'll draw the exits. I always draw the exits.
No patron's name on the gate. Say it once out loud so I can stop checking.

quietWhen.note: After the company is settled as hired hands, Vane's camp lines drop to the bitter subset; she stops volunteering routes in camp and only speaks in briefings.

deathLine: Pack. One thought. Finish it without me.
notes: Vane is 'locked' in the live save. Her lines are inert until she joins; the attractor scenes have fallbacks for that.
